conditions.description: The researcher must undertake international mobility as a condition of the fellowship.
European Postdoctoral Fellowships are open to researchers of any nationality who come to Europe from any country in the world or move within Europe.
Global Postdoctoral Fellowships are open to European nationals or long-term residents undertaking projects with organisations outside EU Member States and Associated Countries.
The proposal must be submitted jointly by the researcher and a single beneficiary drawn from the academic or non-academic sector.
Admissibility conditions are described in Annex A and Annex E of the Horizon Europe Work Programme General Annexes.
Eligible countries are described in Annex B of the Work Programme General Annexes; certain non-EU/non-Associated countries have made specific funding provisions per the Programme Guide.
Other eligibility conditions are described in Annex B of the Work Programme General Annexes.
Financial and operational capacity conditions are described in Annex C of the Work Programme General Annexes.

Organisations active in nuclear research established in an EU Member State or a country associated to the Euratom Research and Training Programme are eligible to participate under the Euratom-covered research areas, subject to specific eligibility conditions.

A non-academic placement must be implemented at a non-academic host organisation established in an EU Member State or Associated Country; for fellows recruited in the non-academic sector it must be at a different non-academic host organisation.
